missing_capabilities: Newtonian gravitational interaction force with explicit inverse-square and source-distance scope
Gravitational field as force per unit mass with radial inverse-square representation and vector superposition

operations.rationale: Existing Cartesian vector competence is reused for field-vector resolution and multi-source superposition.
Existing net-force and acceleration semantics support the force-to-field and field-to-acceleration connection without duplicating Newtonian dynamics.
Universal gravitation is a specific non-contact interaction with its own inverse-square relation, source-distance scope, representation and misconceptions.
Gravitational field introduces a distinct force-per-unit-mass ontology, radial vector-field representation, inverse-square spatial dependence and superposition logic.
